The '''Recusal''' was the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] response to the [[Pius Dea Crusades]]. In [[11,933 BBY]], the Order decided that they could no longer associate themselves with the [[Pius Dea]]-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and that their actions against [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were immoral.

The Order decided to extract itself from the Republic and severed all ties, retreating to their academy world of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. The Jedi would remain there for the next [[11,100 BBY|eight centuries]], until the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] convinced them to [[Renunciates|act]] against the Republic. Although the Order itself remained on Ossus, some [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] acted on their own against the Pius Dea, and some misguided Jedi even joined the Pius Dea. These Jedi settled on [[Garn/Legends|Garn]], and went on to form the [[Order of the Terrible Glare/Legends|Order of the Terrible Glare]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
